notes: Tirumala 5 — selected Plan A, based on Tirumala 4. 40 × 50 ft; 15 ft wide ICU; kitchen against south wall; 7 × 4.5 ft forecourt utility; dry pantry below high stair flight. Ground room sizes, ground staircase and parking retained. Living entrance shifted 100 mm north, ICU living opening 150 mm south, extra corner gap closed while drawing and rear-lobby access remain. ICU recliner head south, feet north. Utility screened in ivory and teak. G+2 revision: fully indoor return stair from the existing first-floor arrival to the enclosed second landing and family hall. First north guest bedroom absorbs the small balcony; connector and projecting corner removed. Main terrace retained with opaque ivory parapets. Living clear double-height opening is approximately 94 sq ft. Large 3200 × 1600 mm slabs, substantial glazing, teak joinery and coordinated roof/beam expression. Structural dimensions are architectural concept placeholders pending engineering.
